races.title: Hazelton Mountford Insurance Brokers EBF Fillies' Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A field of newcomers. LESLIE'S PRIDE is from a talented family and is taken to get her career off to a winning start. Saq of Gold is second choice. LESLIE'S PRIDE (IRE) SAQ OF GOLD NOBLE FLEUR (FR)

races.title: Olly Murphy Proudly Sponsored By Betano 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: FRIENDLY GLANCE was quite a taking winner of his Doncaster bumper and he's fancied to make a successful start over hurdles that features several interesting debutants to this sphere, with Power of Silence and L'Unique Allen chief amongst them. FRIENDLY GLANCE POWER OF SILENCE (IRE) L'UNIQUE ALLEN (FR)

races.title: Olly Murphy Proudly Sponsored By Betano 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: Plenty of similarities to the first division with race sponsor Olly Murphy again mob-handed, CROOKHAVEN getting the vote to make a winning start under Rules having easily won an Irish point back in the spring. Stablemate Burk Flight has a French jumps pedigree, so he looks an obvious threat with attentions quickly switched to hurdles, with Smile John Boy , Roximan and Bebe And Bean just a handful of others worth considering, too. CROOKHAVEN BURK FLIGHT (FR) SMILE JOHN BOY (IRE)

races.title: Great British Bonus Supporting Breeders' Day Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: There's a chance this could be a pipe-opener for LARGY FORCE back over hurdles after 6 months off but she would prove very hard to beat if she does replicate her chasing form. Capricciose showed a fair bit in bumpers and is expected to step up on her hurdles debut, while Emiko is an interesting debutant over hurdles. LARGY FORCE (IRE) CAPRICCIOSE (IRE) EMIKO (IRE)

races.title: Denis O'Connell Memorial Veterans' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: This looks wide open so a chance is taken on KNAPPERS HILL off his reduced mark given his excellent record fresh. Git Maker is another to consider down in class, while Tom Lacey holds a strong hand with last year's winner Nocte Volatus and Pounding Poet , who's had little racing over fences despite his veteran status. KNAPPERS HILL (IRE) GIT MAKER (FR) NOCTE VOLATUS
races.bettingForecast: The Boola Boss (4/1), Sure Touch (9/2), Git Maker (5/1), Nocte Volatus (11/2), Knappers Hill (6/1), Pounding Poet (6/1), Iron Bridge (7/1), Docpickedme (12/1), Hang In There (16/1)

races.title: Omoda And Jaecoo Race To Victory Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: STRONG RUN is still low mileage in handicaps and makes appeal quickly reverted to the smaller obstacles after a luckless chase debut. Easy To Follow is also respected on her comeback, whilst Party Vibes rates as an interesting candidate from her lower hurdles mark. STRONG RUN EASY TO FOLLOW (IRE) PARTY VIBES (IRE)

races.title: Grumpy & Granny's Golden Gallops Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: INDANNYA did well over hurdles last season but very much appeals as the type to take her form to a higher level over fences, hence her inclusion in the Timeform Fifty To Follow. Coolanna is another who could well improve on her hurdling form now sent chasing given her pointing background. Broomfield Aderra looks to be being brought along gradually over fences and remains capable of better fitted with first-time cheekpieces. INDANNYA (FR) COOLANNA (IRE) BROOMFIELD ADERRA (IRE)

races.title: Thoroughbred Breeders' Association Supporting Breeders' Day Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A well-contested race of its type. OLIVE NOIR makes plenty of appeal on paper for a yard with a fine record in bumpers, so she earns the tentative vote before market clues. Galant Jewel and Fiercestone have both been successful on their second outing in Irish points and can put that experience to good use, while Autumn In Sonora is another to note being a half-sister to smart hurdler/useful chase winner Potters Charm. OLIVE NOIR (IRE) GALANT JEWEL (IRE) FIERCESTONE (IRE)
